title: What’s One Win That Stretched You? | Keep Rising Day 2 🌱

top_liked.author: @laurajarrell6187
top_liked.text: Durante, excellent you are at this, too. I hope you've been to the National Museum of African American History and Culture! It is amazing, from all I hear. I fear for our history at the mercies of this regime in power. They want to whitewash all of it. 👍🏼💙💖💙💝💙🥰✌

top_liked.author: @brenta2634
top_liked.text: Joined my Union and started the grievance process. Very difficult and yeah... I spoke up to management.

top_liked.author: @JSvonSlappy
top_liked.text:
In answer to your challenge, my big win this year is to get my BA in Graphic Design and Media Arts from SNHU.
